case: I'm broke till Friday, no peanuts, tired of rice, want something warm

plan.note: Dal is a very cheap, warm, filling lentil stew with no rice, and the creamy zucchini fettuccine adds some variety. Cook the dal in big batches and reheat it through the week. Salt, pepper, cumin, mustard seeds, ginger, fresh chili, chili flakes, lemon and basil aren't priced, so use what you have or skip them.

case: vegetarian, $20 for the week, I like spicy food

lines.name: ROTEL Original Diced Tomatoes and Green Chilies
Kroger® Enriched Long Grain White Rice

no_label: ROTEL Original Diced Tomatoes and Green Chilies
plan.note: Dal is a cheap, high-protein, filling lentil dish, and the Rotel (diced tomatoes with green chilies) adds the heat you like. Serve it over plain rice, or cook Rainbow Rice with some of the Rotel tomatoes for red rice. Cumin seeds, mustard seeds and ginger weren't found at a good price, so skip them or add them if you have some. Salt, pepper and any extra chili flakes are not priced.

lines.name: Private Selection® Triple Berry Blend Frozen Fruit
Simple Truth Organic® 100% Whole Grain Rolled 1 Minute Oats

plan.note: Berry oatmeal (sweetened with brown sugar, cooked with the rolled oats) and pinto baked beans from scratch are cheap, dairy-free and filling. Tip: cook a big pot of dried beans once and reheat portions all week; freeze leftover berries. Salt, water and any spices are not priced.

Kroger® Enriched Long Grain White Rice

plan.note: Deconstructed Cabbage Rolls contain no nuts, are very filling and cheap, and pack well in a container for class, so two batches cover the week's lunches. Reheat in a microwave or eat cold; freeze half to keep it fresh. Salt, pepper and optional spices aren't priced, and leftover rice, garlic and onions can stretch into other meals.

lines.name: Kroger® Gluten Free Whole Chipotle Peppers in Adobo Sauce

no_label: Kroger® Gluten Free Whole Chipotle Peppers in Adobo Sauce
plan.note: Baked beans plus rice are very cheap, high in fiber and protein, and filling, and every ingredient is naturally gluten free (I picked the chipotle labeled gluten free; check the mustard label too). Cook a big pot of dried beans once and make red rice with tomatoes and green rice with spinach for variety. Salt isn't priced.

no_label: ROTEL Original Diced Tomatoes and Green Chilies

case: vegetarian, no soy, I need protein

lines.name: ROTEL Original Diced Tomatoes and Green Chilies

no_label: ROTEL Original Diced Tomatoes and Green Chilies

plan.note: Chicken adobo is the highest-protein recipe per serving, and chicken thighs are on sale at a very low price per pound. case: vegetarian and I want lots of protein

plan.note: Dal (lentils) is the cheapest high-protein recipe, and one Tofu Hot Pot adds variety and more protein. The budget doesn't cover the protein goal in full, so I kept the list lean. Not priced or bought: salt, pepper, cumin and mustard seeds, ginger, green chili, chili paste, sesame oil, carrots, mushrooms and scallions. Add them if you have them. Freeze extra portions.
